text:
Half-time: Real Betis 𝟏-𝟐 Barcelona

Thoughts on the game so far? #fcblive 🤔
𝐖𝐇𝐀𝐓 𝐀 𝐒𝐈𝐆𝐍𝐈𝐍𝐆. 💎
Some people are gonna cry about this blatant handball too. 😹
𝐁𝐄𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐖𝐎𝐑𝐋𝐃. 👑

🚨| 𝐑𝐈𝐕𝐀𝐋 𝐖𝐀𝐓𝐂𝐇: Nuno Mendes was forced off in the 86th minute due to injury against Strasbourg, just three days before Barça play against PSG. The extent of the injury will be evaluated soon. [@AndiOnrubia] #fcblive
45' The second half. 🟣⚫
🚨 Eric replaces Gerard Martín at HT, who has suffered a knock. #fcblive
46' Jesus inches away from making it 3-1. Great cross by Adeyemi.
🚨 Raphinha and Olmo warming up. #fcblive 🔥
48' FERMÍN ALMOST! He decides to go for goal himself but Valles with a clever save.
50' Gabriel Jesus scores but it's OFFSIDE!
🎥 | GABRIEL JESUS CONTINUES HIS UNSTOPPABLE FORM WITH ANOTHER GOAL. LAMINE YAMAL ASSIST. #fcblive 🟣⚫
RED CARD FOR REAL BETIS 🔴
Facundo Bernal's HEADBUTT to Lamine Yamal. Deserved red! 🔴

61' SUBSTITUTIONS:

🔴 Fermín, Adeyemi
🟢 Olmo, Gordon
GOALLLLLL ERIC GARCIAAAA. 4-2 BARÇAAAAAAA 🟣⚫
🎥 | Eric Garcia SCORES THE 4th for BARÇA. Great fearless assist from Cubarsi. The centre-back duo! #fcblive 🔥
CB to CB. 🔥🛡
THE SIGHT WE'VE WAITED FOR 💜
75' Olmo with a rocket of a shot but it's saved, and Gabril Jesus from the rebound shoots it over.
78' Gordon is denied by Valles.
79' Gavi replaces Jesus.
GOALLLLLLL DANI OLMO. HE FINALLY GETS ON THE SCORESHEET. 5-2 BARÇAAAAA 🟣⚫
🎥 | DANI OLMO MAKES IT FIVE. HE GETS HIS FIRST GOAL OF THE SEASON. #fcblive 💥

Full-time: Real Betis 𝟐-𝟓 Barcelona

WHAT A WIN AT LA CARTUJA. An amazing performance from the team. Your thoughts? #fcblive 🟣⚫🤔
🚨 𝐔𝐏𝐃𝐀𝐓𝐄𝐃 𝐋𝐀 𝐋𝐈𝐆𝐀 𝐓𝐀𝐁𝐋𝐄:
🚨| 𝐎𝐅𝐅𝐈𝐂𝐈𝐀𝐋: Lamine Yamal has been named as the 𝐌𝐎𝐓𝐌! #fcblive ⭐
🚨 𝐁𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐊𝐈𝐍𝐆: Barça have EQUALLED Real Madrid's historical record from 1968-69 season by starting the La Liga season with 9 CONSECUTIVE victories. #fcblive 🔥

🚨🎙️| Rodri: “We’ve conceded and I think that issue can be fixed, but the team is showing its potential. We’re focusing on Paris, they might be the best team in the world. It’ll be a good test.” #fcblive
